text: 8.2 1 Where shall we go then? How about that bar on the corner? Hmm... The music's a bit loud in there. It's not very good if you want to chat. I'm not sure they do much food either. Oh right. Do you have somewhere else in mind then? Well, if you don't mind walking, I know this really nice cafe. It has a terrace that looks out over the river. Well, that'd be nice. Yeah, and they do some really nice snacks. Great! So how far is it? Well, it is a 20 minute walk. That's okay. The walk will give us an appetite.
